stories.headline: Malaysian Haj pilgrim dies of brain haemorrhage in Mecca, 10th fatality this season
stories.summary: A 52-year-old Malaysian female pilgrim from Johor has died in Mecca due to a brain haemorrhage, becoming the 10th Malaysian fatality during this year's Haj season. This incident adds to the previous deaths, including a 65-year-old man from Pahang who collapsed at the Grand Mosque on May 1. Prior to these incidents, six Malaysian pilgrims had already died in the Holy Land since the start of the 2026 Haj season. Another Malaysian pilgrim also died after suffering a heart attack in Makkah. The total number of Malaysian deaths during the 1446H/2025M Haj season now stands at ten, with the cause of deaths including brain haemorrhage and heart attack. The Malaysian pilgrims' deaths occurred in various locations in Mecca, including the Grand Mosque.

stories.headline: Africa: Economic Freedom Remains Africa's Unfinished Struggle - AfCFTA Boss
stories.summary: The African Continental Free Trade Area's Secretary General states that economic liberation remains Africa's biggest challenge, despite achieving political independence. The African Continental Free Trade Agreement, signed in 2018, aimed to unite 54 nations into a single market, but its promises are largely unfulfilled. Many African countries, including Ghana, have laws restricting foreigners from participating in certain retail markets. Intra-African trade has historically been low, ranging from 12 to 18 percent before AfCFTA. The Guided Trade Initiative was launched in 2022 to boost commerce, but trade levels remain below 20 percent. The AfCFTA seeks to unlock economic breakthrough, but its implementation has been slow, with several countries yet to fully open their markets to other African nations. The agreement's success is crucial for Africa's economic liberation and development.

stories.headline: Group of Shah Alam PKR committee members quit party
stories.summary: A group of 21 Shah Alam PKR committee members, including women's wing leaders, have resigned from the party, citing a loss of confidence in the top leadership. The resignations were announced, but Shah Alam PKR chief Najwan Halimi has denied the reports, stating that no such resignations have occurred. The conflicting claims have created uncertainty about the actual status of the committee members. The development comes as Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, who is also PKR president, has taken over a new parliamentary constituency. The reasons behind the alleged resignations are attributed to a loss of confidence in the party's leadership, but the situation remains unclear due to the contradictory statements from the Shah Alam PKR chief. The incident may have implications for the party's internal dynamics and leadership.

stories.headline: Congo-Kinshasa: 'Francophonie of the People' - Juliana Lumumba's Vision for the French-Speaking World Interview
stories.summary: Juliana Lumumba, former culture minister in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is running for secretary-general of the International Organisation of La Francophonie. Her candidacy reflects Kinshasa's diplomatic repositioning and demands for a more independent and Africa-centred Francophonie. Lumumba's vision is for a "Francophonie of the People", aiming to make the organization more political and closer to societies. Her campaign program was presented in Paris, outlining her action plan for the OIF. Lumumba's bid is seen as a significant diplomatic move by Kinshasa, highlighting her diverse background in academia, culture, diplomacy, and activism. Her candidacy is supported by the DRC, which is seeking to reposition itself within the French-speaking world. Lumumba's campaign is gaining attention, with her presentation in Paris marking a key moment in her bid for the secretary-general position.

stories.headline: Xiaomi 17 Max goes on first sale as Xiaomi’s biggest battery flagship
stories.summary: Xiaomi's 17 Max has gone on its first sale, featuring the company's largest battery flagship. The device is equipped with an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, boasting an energy density of 894Wh/L and a silicon content of up to 16%. This battery supports 100W wired fast charging and offers up to 33.3 hours of video playback and over two days of typical use. The phone is part of Xiaomi's series, which includes the 17 Pro, designed to compete with Apple. The 17 Max's large battery and fast charging capabilities make it a notable release in the market. With its impressive battery life, the device is expected to attract attention from consumers looking for a long-lasting smartphone. The sale marks the official availability of the Xiaomi 17 Max in the market.

stories.headline: Riot Games’ latest Vanguard anti-cheat update has reportedly neutralized high-end DMA PCIe cheating devices used in Valorant, prompting the developer to mock af
stories.summary: Riot Games' latest Vanguard anti-cheat update has neutralized high-end DMA PCIe cheating devices used in Valorant. The update reportedly detects and blocks external DMA PCIe cheat cards, including the expensive Heino 2.0 hardware. This hardware, which can cost up to $6,000, is now rendered useless for cheating in the game. Riot Games has mocked the owners of these devices, referring to them as "paperweights." The update is a significant blow to cheaters who had invested in these expensive devices to gain an unfair advantage in the game. The company's efforts to combat cheating have been successful, with the update effectively disabling the use of these devices in Valorant. The move is part of Riot Games' ongoing efforts to maintain a fair and secure gaming environment.

stories.headline: Samsung marks 20 years as top TV brand in NZ launch New Zealand households are being targeted with larger, AI-powered sets as Samsung extends its TV and soundbar dominance into 2026
stories.summary: Samsung has marked 20 consecutive years as the world's top TV brand, also leading the soundbar market for 12 straight years. The company is targeting New Zealand households with larger, AI-powered TV sets as it extends its dominance into 2026. Samsung's continued leadership in the TV and soundbar markets is driven by its innovative products and technologies. The company's AI-powered TVs are expected to be a key focus in the New Zealand market, offering enhanced viewing experiences for consumers. With its strong brand presence and commitment to innovation, Samsung aims to maintain its position as a leading player in the global TV and soundbar markets. The company's milestone achievement highlights its enduring success and popularity among consumers worldwide.

stories.headline: Hack of the day: Ask Gemini questions about a Youtube video
stories.summary: Google has launched "Ask YouTube", a conversational search tool, and Gemini Omni for AI-powered Shorts remixing. YouTube is rolling out a new 'Ask' button, powered by Gemini AI, to select users. This feature allows viewers to ask questions related to the video they're watching, providing summaries, explanations of key concepts, and interactive quizzes. The "Ask YouTube" feature enables users to ask lengthy and detailed questions when searching for a video, utilizing Gemini to provide instant answers and insights. The new feature is designed to enhance user interaction with video content, making the service more like a chatbot. The launch of "Ask YouTube" and Gemini Omni was announced at Google I/O 2026, as part of the company's efforts to integrate AI-powered tools into its platforms. The 'Ask' button is currently being rolled out to select users.

stories.headline: Arteta urges Arsenal to make history in Champions League final
stories.summary: Mikel Arteta has challenged his Arsenal players to make history by winning the Champions League after securing the Premier League title. Following Arsenal's 2-1 win against Crystal Palace, the team was presented with the Premier League trophy, prompting an emotional celebration. Arteta, still overcome with joy, urged his team to strive for more success, specifically their first Champions League title. The Premier League win marked a significant achievement for the club, and Arteta is now looking to build on this momentum to achieve further success in the Champions League. Arsenal's focus will now shift to the upcoming Champions League final as they aim to create more history under Arteta's leadership.

stories.headline: Golden Knights Complete Three-Goal Comeback in 5-3 Win Over Avalanche
stories.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights overcame a three-goal deficit to defeat the Colorado Avalanche 5-3 in Game 3 of the Western Conference Final. The Avalanche initially led 3-0, but the Golden Knights rallied with five straight goals. Mark Stone scored a power-play goal 19 seconds into the second period, narrowing the lead to 3-1. The Golden Knights continued their comeback, with Tomas Hertl scoring the go-ahead goal at 8:21 of the third period. This win marked the Golden Knights' second consecutive come-from-behind victory, giving them an advantage in the series. The team's impressive comeback was fueled by their ability to score five unanswered goals, ultimately securing a 5-3 win over the Avalanche on Sunday night.

stories.headline: Alex Eala feels more prepared, eyes breakthrough at French Open
stories.summary: Alex Eala is shifting her focus to the French Open after a stunning early elimination in the WTA 500 Strasbourg Open. The Philippine tennis player was defeated at the Tennis Club de Strasbourg in France on Monday night. Despite the setback, Eala feels more prepared for the French Open, which begins next week. She has gained experience and momentum from her recent performances, including a notable breakthrough at the 2025 Miami Open. Eala's favorite Grand Slam is Wimbledon, but she is now concentrating on making a breakthrough at the French Open. The tournament is a key opportunity for her to build on her growing reputation as one of the Philippines' most prominent athletes, following in the footsteps of boxing legend Manny Pacquiao.

stories.headline: Katherine Legge calls Double attempt a "calamity of errors" after tough Coke 600
stories.summary: Katherine Legge became the sixth driver in history to start the Indianapolis 500 and Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. She joined a list that includes Tony Stewart, Robby Gordon, John Andretti, Kurt Busch, and Kyle Larson. Legge finished 31st at the Coke 600 after her bid to complete "The Double" ended at the Indy 500. She described the attempt as "a calamity of errors." The only driver to successfully complete "The Double" is Tony Stewart in 2001. Legge's week was marked by bad luck, and she stated it's now time to regroup. Her achievement is notable, despite the challenges she faced, and she persevered to see the Coke 600 through to the end. Legge drives the No. 78 Live Fast Motorsports Chevrolet.

stories.headline: India moves closer to mega Rafale fighter jet deal, finalises request letter
stories.summary: India has finalized a Letter of Request to France for the purchase of 114 Rafale fighter aircraft, valued at approximately $40 billion. The proposed deal includes a significant local manufacturing component, with around 90 jets to be produced in India through a collaboration between Dassault Aviation and an Indian company. The remaining 24 jets will be delivered in fly-away condition. The move aims to strengthen the Indian Air Force fleet and is expected to transform the region's airpower balance and defence industrial landscape. The Letter of Request is set to be sent to France within the next few weeks, marking a major step in India's plan to boost its air force capabilities. The deal is part of a wider India-France defence partnership and is expected to have a significant impact on the country's defence industry.

stories.headline: India finalises Rs 3.25 lakh crore proposal for 114 Rafale jets; France to get LoR soon: Report
stories.summary: India has finalized a Rs 3.25 lakh crore proposal to acquire 114 Rafale fighter jets for the Indian Air Force. The deal, worth $39 billion, is one of the country's largest defense procurements. The jets will be purchased under the Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft program. A Letter of Request (LoR) has been finalized and is expected to be sent to France soon, likely within the next few weeks. The acquisition aims to enhance the Indian Air Force's capabilities. The proposal has been finalized after a long pending process, and the deal is set to move forward with France receiving the LoR shortly. The purchase of 114 Rafale jets will significantly boost India's defense arsenal and strengthen its air force.

stories.headline: Furnace-like conditions return to Delhi-NCR: IMD predicts scorching days, gusty winds and dust storms till Friday
stories.summary: Delhi-NCR is experiencing furnace-like conditions with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) predicting scorching days, gusty winds, and dust storms till Friday. Strong winds of 20-30 kmph, occasionally gusting to 40 kmph, are expected during the day. The region may also see light rain accompanied by thunderstorms, lightning, and dust storms. Although a heatwave is unlikely in the coming week, temperatures are expected to rise gradually. The IMD has issued a yellow alert till Friday, warning of intense dust storms and very hot weather. Gusty winds ranging from 25 to 35 km per hour are predicted for Tuesday, with mainly clear skies and heatwave conditions. The weather department had earlier issued a red alert for a heatwave, predicting winds that could raise dust along with very hot weather. Residents are advised to take necessary precautions to stay safe.

stories.headline: JEE Advanced Answer Key 2026 OUT today at jeeadv.ac.in, result on this date
stories.summary: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee has released the JEE Advanced 2026 provisional answer key on May 25, 2026, at 10 am on the website jeeadv.ac.in. Candidates who appeared for the national-level entrance examination can download the answer key using their application number and password. The provisional answer key is available for both Paper 1 and Paper 2. An objection window will also be opened for candidates to raise concerns. The JEE Advanced 2026 result is scheduled to be announced on June 1. Additionally, updates on qualifying marks, cut-off, marks vs rank, and JoSAA counselling dates will be provided. Candidates can visit the official website for the latest updates and to download the provisional answer key PDF. The answer key will help candidates estimate their scores using the score calculator.

stories.headline: The Iran War Is Coming for Your Diet Coke
stories.summary: A shortage of Diet Coke is affecting India and other countries due to the Iran war. The conflict has disrupted supply chains, leading to a scarcity of the popular cola. In India, restaurants and bars are hosting "Diet Coke Parties" where attendees pay up to $16 for access to jalapeno-spiked cola cocktails and scarce cans of Diet Coke. The shortage is also affecting other industries, such as Japan's snack maker Calbee, which is switching to black-and-white packaging due to a shortage of ink ingredients. The Iran war is causing widespread disruptions, making it harder for people to access their favorite beverages and products, especially during the hot summer season. The shortage is expected to worsen, affecting consumers and businesses alike. The situation is being closely monitored as the conflict continues to impact global supply chains.

stories.headline: Can India keep pace with geopolitics and attract more Apple investment?
stories.summary: India's growth in attracting Apple investment is uncertain due to geopolitical tensions and reliance on US-China tariff tensions. The country's iPhone boom was driven by these tensions, but sustaining growth requires fresh policy support and deeper supply chains. Market sentiment in India remains fragile, with equities moving within a narrow range due to global tensions and volatile crude oil prices. Despite this, India and China have a robust bilateral trade relationship, with China being India's top trade partner. The two countries also cooperate multilaterally in organizations such as Brics and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. To attract more Apple investment, India needs to address adoption challenges and provide a supportive environment for companies investing in AI and other technologies. A stable policy framework and improved supply-chain depth are crucial for India to remain a viable investment destination.

stories.headline: Top US Doctor Predicts Major Shift in Breast Cancer Risk Assessment
stories.summary: A top US doctor predicts a major shift in breast cancer risk assessment. Online breast cancer risk calculators use personal and family health history to estimate lifetime risk, providing a percentage result. Less than 15% is considered average risk, while 15-19% is intermediate risk. However, these calculators are not accurate for women with BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations. Breast cancer is the leading cause of death from cancer among women in most states, with 60% of cases diagnosed at stage III or IV, reducing survival rates. The shift in risk assessment may improve early detection and treatment. Current online calculators are free and widely available, but their limitations highlight the need for more advanced and personalized risk assessment tools. This development may have significant implications for breast cancer diagnosis and treatment in the US.

stories.headline: No fourth headline available, only three provided
stories.summary: The US government has implemented travel restrictions in response to the Ebola outbreak. American citizens and permanent residents departing from affected countries are required to fly into one of three designated US airports. This measure aims to control the spread of the disease. The restrictions are part of a broader effort to monitor and contain the outbreak. The US is taking precautions to prevent the spread of Ebola, while also providing support to affected countries. The travel restrictions are in place to ensure the safety of the public and to prevent potential outbreaks in the US. The situation is being closely monitored by health officials, who are working to provide updates and guidance as more information becomes available.

stories.headline: Sensex jumps 800 points: Why is stock market rising today?
stories.summary: The Sensex jumped over 800 points to cross 76,200, while the Nifty gained nearly 1% to move past 23,700 and later near 24,000. The stock market rally was led by information technology stocks, with Infosys rising 4.48% to Rs 1,288.10 and TCS gaining 3.50% to Rs 2,475.50. A ceasefire agreement between India and Pakistan brought relief to investors, contributing to the rally. Positive global signals and strong buying across sectors also supported the market. Oil prices plunged 5% to two-week lows, further boosting investor sentiment. The broad-based buying in IT stocks powered the rally, with the Sensex and Nifty closing strong, indicating a positive trend in the stock market.

stories.headline: Sensex jumps over 900 points: US-Iran peace deal hopes and other factors behind the rise explained; can gains sustain?
stories.summary: The Sensex jumped over 900 points and the Nifty gained 250 points, driven by hopes of a US-Iran peace deal. The potential agreement has led to a decrease in crude oil prices, with oil dipping by $5 to below $100. This development has positively impacted the Indian stock markets, with the Sensex and Nifty rallying over 1% each. Other factors also contributed to the surge, but the possibility of a peace deal between the US and Iran is seen as a key driver. Despite the surge in global oil markets following US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites, domestic fuel prices have not increased. The market rally is attributed to the easing of geopolitical tensions and the subsequent decrease in crude oil prices. The gains have pushed the Nifty above 25,200.

stories.headline: Sensex jumps 850 points, Nifty nears 24,000 on US-Iran peace deal hopes. 5 key factors
stories.summary: Indian stock markets surged on Monday, with the Sensex jumping 850 points and the Nifty nearing 24,000. The rally was driven by rising hopes of a US-Iran peace deal, which boosted global sentiment and eased crude oil prices. Oil prices declined below $100 per barrel, further fueling the market's upward trend. Analysts attributed the rally to improving global sentiment and the potential progress in a possible US-Iran deal. Large-cap stocks also contributed to the surge. The market's sharp rise came after a period of volatility sparked by Iran war jitters, which had previously hit Indian markets. The five key factors driving the rally include the rising hopes of a US-Iran peace deal, declining oil prices, and improving global sentiment.

stories.headline: Stock market today: Which are top gainers and losers on NSE & BSE on May 25? Check list India Business News: Stock market rallied sharply on Monday, with the Sensex soaring more than 1,000 points and the Nifty reclaiming the 24,000 mark, as easing
stories.summary: The Indian stock market rallied sharply on Monday, with the Sensex soaring 1,073.61 points to 76,488.96 and the Nifty reclaiming the 24,000 mark, rising 312.40 points to 24,053.95. Easing geopolitical tensions in West Asia and falling crude oil prices boosted investor sentiment globally. Top gainers included HFCL, Adani Power, Eicher Motors, OLA, Tata Motors, and HPCL. The 30-share BSE Sensex jumped 1.42% and the NSE Nifty 50 surged 1.32%. The rally was driven by improved investor sentiment, with the market responding positively to the easing of global tensions and declining oil prices. The strong gains marked a significant turnaround for the Indian markets, with the Nifty 50 rising 1.4% and the BSE Sensex closing at a high of 76,488.96.

stories.headline: Guzman y Gomez facing legal action after abruptly shutting down US operations
stories.summary: Guzman y Gomez is facing a class action lawsuit in the US after abruptly shutting down its operations. The lawsuit alleges that the Australian fast food chain failed to provide its employees with adequate notice and pay upon termination. Approximately 500 employees are estimated to be affected by the closures. The plaintiffs are seeking 60 days of unpaid wages and benefits under the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Acts, as well as a maximum civil penalty. The lawsuit was filed after Guzman y Gomez suddenly exited the US market last week. The company is aware of the legal action and is expected to respond. Despite the lawsuit, Guzman y Gomez's shares initially rose over 10% before trading flat at A$19.805, still up 24% since the US exit announcement.

stories.headline: Fire shuts Grimsby roads in early hours as locals warned to 'avoid area'
stories.summary: A fire broke out in the early hours of Bank Holiday Monday in Grimsby, leading to road closures in the area. The blaze occurred on Queen Street, prompting multiple road closures around Ellis Way and Peaks Parkway. Humberside Police have warned locals to "avoid the area" while fire crews continue to work on extinguishing the fire. The road closures are in place to ensure public safety. Locals have been advised to steer clear of Queen Street and adjoining areas. Humberside Fire and Rescue are tackling the blaze, and a previous warning to keep doors and windows closed has been reiterated. The incident has caused disruptions in the area, with authorities urging people to avoid the affected roads. The cause of the fire is not yet known, and the situation is being monitored by emergency services.

stories.headline: Gold and silver price today, 25 May: Check retail rates of 24K, 22K gold and 999 silver in Delhi, Mumbai, other cities
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices increased on May 25, with gold reaching ₹ 160,060 per unit. The precious metals gained attention from investors and retailers due to global market volatility, inflation concerns, and currency movement. Gold prices edged higher, while silver also showed strength. The current gold price is $4,508.64 per ounce, with 24K gold at $144.97 per gram, 22K gold at $132.89 per gram, and 18K gold at $108.73 per gram. However, compared to the previous day, the gold price decreased by $26.75 per ounce, a 0.59% change. Retail rates for 24K, 22K gold, and 999 silver vary in cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata, with investors and jewelry buyers monitoring daily price fluctuations. The prices are updated hourly, and a free real-time gold price tracker is available for comparison.

stories.headline: Cupra locks in racy electric SUV rival for BMW iX3 and Volvo EX60
stories.summary: Cupra is developing the Tindaya, a mid-size electric SUV to rival the BMW iX3 and Volvo EX60. The production car is based on Volkswagen Group's SSP platform and is expected to arrive in the coming years. Although the powertrain details are still undecided, the brand is considering either a plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (EREV) or a pure electric option. The Tindaya is inspired by last year's concept and is designed to be a driver-focused flagship SUV. It will compete with other driver-focused SUVs, including the upcoming Alfa Romeo Stelvio EV. The Tindaya's development aligns with Cupra's brand philosophy, which emphasizes driving experience and performance. The exact launch timeline and specifications of the Tindaya have not been announced, but it is expected to be a key player in the growing electric SUV market.

stories.headline: Could anything but profit steer AI? The OpenAI trial offered clues but no verdict
stories.summary: A recent survey of nonprofits and foundations revealed their engagement with AI, top concerns, and lagging areas. Some nonprofit leaders still avoid using AI for generative purposes, citing outdated policies. Meanwhile, a trial related to OpenAI offered clues but no verdict on whether anything but profit can steer AI. The trial's outcome may impact how organizations, including nonprofits, approach AI adoption. Nonprofits are increasingly recognizing the need to leverage AI, with some leaders acknowledging that not using AI generatively can cost their organizations time and resources. As AI continues to evolve, its applications and implications are being explored across various sectors, including the nonprofit world, with a focus on balancing benefits and concerns. The survey and trial highlight the ongoing discussion around AI's role and potential in driving social and economic change.

stories.headline: Google Unveils New AI Chatbot to Rival ChatGPT
stories.summary: Google has unveiled its new AI chatbot, Gemini 3, to rival ChatGPT. The latest version of Gemini has surpassed ChatGPT in relevance and usefulness, becoming the most capable AI chatbot. Gemini 3 will provide users with better answers, showcasing the rapid progress of AI since ChatGPT's release three years ago. The update comes after Google's management declared "code red" to compete with ChatGPT, and Microsoft announced plans to integrate ChatGPT into its Bing search engine. Google's Gemini has leapfrogged ChatGPT, and its ubiquity is expected soon. The new AI model is part of Google's effort to keep pace with OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT, and to maintain its position in the search market. Gemini 3's release marks a significant development in the AI chatbot landscape.

stories.headline: Meta Releases Groundbreaking AI Model Capable of Learning from Limited Data
stories.summary: Meta has released a groundbreaking AI model called Muse Spark, its first major AI model in over a year. Developed by Meta Super Intelligence Labs, Muse Spark is designed to learn from limited data, marking a significant step forward in AI technology. This release comes as part of Meta's AI-focused restructuring efforts, which included layoffs of approximately 8,000 employees, about 10% of its total workforce. The launch of Muse Spark follows a period of growth for Meta AI, with daily users increasing by over 15% according to recent data. The new model is seen as a next big step beyond Llama, showcasing Meta's continued investment in AI development. With Muse Spark, Meta aims to push the boundaries of AI capabilities, enabling the model to learn and adapt with limited data input.

stories.headline: Microsoft Invests Heavily in AI Research to Improve Machine Learning Capabilities
stories.summary: Microsoft is investing heavily in AI research to improve machine learning capabilities, with a record $30 billion capital expenditure in a single quarter, its highest ever. The company has allocated $80 billion in capital expenditures for 2025, focusing on Azure cloud, AI infrastructure, global data center expansion, and sustainable computing. This investment is driven by growing demand for cloud services and aims to enhance Microsoft's AI infrastructure. Over the past year, the company has poured $88 billion into building data centers for AI and cloud computing, exceeding Wall Street expectations and sparking concerns about the costs of sustaining this growth. The investment is expected to have a significant impact on the industry, with opportunities emerging in core AI infrastructure, industry-specific AI solutions, and AI operations.
